prompts.paving: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one reusable transparent isometric RPG ground tile. Create exactly ONE flat diamond-shaped paving module, a seamless warm pale sandstone/cobblestone floor with fine individual stone texture and modest antique brass inlaid seam details. Painted high-quality storybook fantasy game style, warm sunlight from upper left, 30-degree isometric camera looking down, matching a lush golden greenhouse city of brass, glass and flowers. Composition: entire shallow floor diamond centered on a 1024x1024 transparent canvas; projected diamond corners approximately (110,512),(512,311),(914,512),(512,713), 2:1 width-to-height. Keep the stone module perfectly planar with effectively no raised vertical sides, no kerb and no obstructing edging; this is freely walkable level ground that can be joined edge-to-edge to other floor modules. No plants, walls, props, text, shadows outside the diamond, backdrop or scenery. True transparent alpha outside the single floor tile. Crisp painted texture at game scale, no blurry photorealism, no checkerboard baked into pixels.
prompts.planter: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent isometric RPG scenery sprite. Create exactly ONE compact oval planter with a low antique warm-sandstone bowl, slender worn brass rim and abundant rich moss-green foliage, small violet and ivory flowers and a few graceful leaves. Painterly detailed storybook fantasy game style, warm sunlight from upper left, fixed 30-degree isometric camera looking down, for a golden greenhouse city of stone, brass, glass and flowers. Whole isolated object centered on a 1024x1024 transparent canvas, with generous clear margins and no cropping. The base is a compact predictable oval; leaves may overhang the bowl only modestly. Include fine leaf veins and weathering visible at small game size, restrained golden highlights. No pavement, floor tile, surrounding vegetation, wall, characters, labels, text, background, large outer glow, separate objects or baked checkerboard. True transparent alpha, clean silhouette and minimal soft contact shadow confined to the base.
prompts.lamp: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one independent transparent isometric RPG scenery sprite. Create exactly ONE elegant compact antique brass path lantern on a warm pale sandstone square pedestal. Slender brass post, small amber illuminated glass lantern with engraved brass cap and delicate botanical ironwork, very subtle moss at pedestal base. Painterly detailed storybook fantasy game style, warm sunlight from upper left, fixed 30-degree isometric camera looking down, for a lush golden greenhouse city of stone, brass and glass. Whole isolated lantern centered on a 1024x1024 transparent canvas, standing upright with its small base near lower center, ample margins and no cropping. Keep base footprint narrow and clearly visible. Fine metal patina and glass highlights readable at small sprite scale. The glowing amber light stays inside the lantern; no broad halo. No pavement, floor, surrounding scenery, plants beyond subtle pedestal moss, other lamps, labels, text, characters, background or baked checkerboard. True transparent alpha with clean silhouette, only a minimal soft contact shadow at base.
